notes.title: Donation Challenge During Animal Week!
notes.content:
Hello Animal Lovers! 🤝

We are thrilled to announce our exciting initiative to support the WWF Poland during Animal Week on Steam, happening from October 3 to October 10, 2024. ❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/2d29abe18af78ca779cea7955de7b27fc4605e3c.png

With great pleasure we would like to support real animals around the world that's why we decided to donate a portion of our proceeds from our popular animal-themed games, with the donation amount directly tied to the peak number of players during this special week. 🤩

YOU PLAYERS 🫵 have an impact on the amount we will donate! 👀

Let's explain how it works 🧐
During Animal Week, we invite you to dive into our engaging titles: Animal Shelter, Pets Hotel, Pet Shop Simulator, My Horse: Bonded Spirits, and Zoo Simulator. 

We will be summing the peak number of players across these games (from October 3 to October 10, 2024), and for the highest player peak recorded at this time for each, we will donate $1 to WWF Poland 👇
Example Calculation:
Peak players for Animal Shelter: 2523
Peak players for Pets Hotel: 1475
Peak players for Pet Shop Simulator: 2221
Peak players for My Horse: Bonded Spirits: 1752
Peak players for Zoo Simulator: 2658
Total example donation: $10 629

We have always believed in using our games for the good of animals around the world. In the past, we've supported animal shelters around the globe, and now we are eager to extend our impact by contributing to wildlife conservation through WWF Poland during Animal Week on Steam. Join us in this exciting challenge and make a difference while enjoying your favorite games!

EVERY PLAYER COUNTS! 🫵

See you on Animal Week!
Games Incubator Team

—
About WWF Poland
WWF Poland: the World Wide Fund for Nature is the world's leading conservation organization that saves the most valuable natural areas in over 100 countries on 6 continents. WWF's involvement ensures that Animal Week will not only provide players with entertainment, but also be impactful in raising awareness of how to stop the degradation of the natural environment and to build a future in which people live in harmony with nature.Think globally act locally.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear players!

Today we have published another update within these few days of the release. 

There have been many voices from you saying that the game is developing too fast for some while others had absolutely the opposite opinion. 


Therefore, one of the most important novelties in this update is the difficulty levels!
There are 3 levels : 

Easy:

 Buying additional store space is cheaper
 Expanding the parking lot is cheaper
 Customers are rarely in a bad mood
 Employees are less likely to take their salaries
 No thieves
 Customers are happy to choose products, regardless of the margin
 Store equipment is cheaper
 The level of the store grows faster
 


Normal:

 The price of additional store space is standard
 The cost of expanding the parking lot is standard
 Customers are sometimes in a bad mood
 Employees are paid hourly wages
 Thieves appear occasionally
 The customer's choice of product depends partly on the margin
 Store equipment has standard prices
 Store level is growing at a standard rate


Hard:

 Purchasing additional store space is more expensive
 Expanding the parking lot is more expensive
 Customers are more often in a bad mood
 Employees are paid hourly wages
 Thieves show up more often
 The customer's choice of product is more margin-dependent
 Store equipment is more expensive
 Store level is increasing at a standard rate


New players from the very beginning of their adventure with our game will be able to choose the difficulty level in our game, while players who have started the game before will be able to choose the difficulty level after updating and firing up their in-game save! :)


This is not the end of the news that we have prepared for you, but others will appear successively in the coming days and weeks.



Patch notes: 


 Added difficulty levels
 Added options to disable waving customers to cashiers
 Products on the way after saving and loading will go out again, so you won't lose them
 Fixed fish animations
 After skipping the night, the time is closer to the opening of the store
 Fixed product stuck over the bag if the product was not scanned beforehand




See you soon,
Pet Shop Team

Hello Pet Shop Fans! 👋

We’re excited to see you in the first devlog since the release of Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue! 🤩 Once again, we’d like to thank everyone for trying the Prologue version and all the feedback we’ve received from you thus far. It gave us a lot of insight into what expectations you’ve got for the game and we’re currently doing our best to make the best use of what you’ve told us! 👍

With that being said, there’s a lot to be done before the release of the full version (which will happen soon… 😏) Lots of technical work on top of the changes you’ve suggested as well as creative work such as creating models. 

Prologue allowed you to see some of the animals but just as we promised, there are more available in the full version and today you can take a look at more of them!

-turtles
-hamsters
-mice
-rabbits
-fishes

Those of you who already played the Prologue know very well that the animals need regular care. Keeping the cages clean and the pets well-fed is a bare minimum but some additional belly scratches or petting will surely not go unnoticed! 🐢

We’d also like to share a new object- a self-service cash register!  This new item will undoubtedly help to save time and relegate the work power to other important areas of the shop. 💰

These checkouts will sometimes require either you or one of your employees to approach and authorize the purchase. This situation is indicated by a red diode over the register. 🔴 Keep in mind that the longer you make them wait for authorization, the more likely it is to make him upset and leave the shop without buying anything.

notes.title: Furniture
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

Welcome back to our pet shop! Today we’d like to talk about something you often might not even think about but plays an incredibly important role in every business- the furniture! 🪑

We’ve got a few rooms to take a closer look at so let’s get moving!

Main Hall 💲
This is the place where all the client related part of the business takes place. That’s why in this category you’ll find items such as animal cages, aquariums, cash registers and different sized shelves. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/1ec30a8bd390121eb1d99619265c6c9b994c0b3a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/ae3c928694f8f4be8e66210df820f76bf619dcba.png
Warehouse 📦
The backbone of your store where all the additional items and supplies are being kept. It has to be an efficient space and with the help of storage shelves and an audio system it’ll run smoothly!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/8c2b6b2eca2992d307f15bbf67bd73001a355d4f.png
Restroom 🚻
Sometimes your personnel need to take care of their physiological needs and you, as a responsible owner, have to make sure they have a proper place. Toilets and washstands are an absolute must have in this room.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/8f218862c8f3e5fb3032f2c29149d9795afa02a9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/6d67dcf3a951705a11ad2b6c20090ae89a1f36af.png
Social Room 🛋️
A safe space for all your workers to spend their breaks in. Comfortable furniture, vending machines or an arcade will help your employees rest and come back to work full of energy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/04791a79956645b4f1829e29c4a1edcd313089fa.png
🖌️ Lighting and decorations 💡
Choose your lighting and decorate the shop so it’s eye-pleasing. Don’t forget about the ventilation system, signs and other decorations to make the entire space look more realistic.

A good example of how choosing different decorations and colorings can affect the final result are the 2 screens of the bathroom. You’ll have freedom of furnishing, decorating and coloring your shops however you like and stay assured, the looks of the shop won’t affect the animals and clients are more concerned about the items and animals your store has to offer so you can let your imagination run wild while decorating! 💪

If you’d like to suggest adding certain decorations or furniture pieces to the game make sure to let us know in the discussion section or on our discord! You can also add this game to your wishlists on Steam to not miss out on any future devlog! 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Animals in shop
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We appreciate you agreeing to visit our shop after closing. Usually, there’re lots of people wandering around and it would be hard to introduce you to one of the most important aspects of your work in the Pet Shop- taking care of the animals! 🐰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/d5f94246203fc6309d9791e75b565fd9e5790b05.png
During your shifts one of the tasks will be taking care of the needs of the animals. 📝 Make sure they’re in great condition and stay happy with help of three basic actions:
-feeding
-petting
-cleaning the cages

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/b6caf990b5531ef77046e9ec1fbff33d72a921d1.png
The importance of an animal's mood is not to be underestimated. If you neglect your duties, after a while a sad face over the animal will appear 🙁 and it will impact the people coming to your shop. They’ll not be interested in buying neglected animals and what’s more, they’ll give negative opinions to the shop which will result in a drop in reputation. We don’t have to remind you what it means for your earnings, do we? 🤔 That’s why you have to make sure you’ll always remember to take good care of your animals no matter how many duties you may have.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/02e4401cce0f80c476a6f4740e49f4b4474f40b4.png
At this point you might be wondering what animals will you be able to sell?  Well, we suppose you could get a little insight into that. Amongst all the possibilities you may sell:
-rabbits
-fishes
-hamsters
-turtles
-mice

We’re wondering if you have any guesses about what other animals will be available? Let us know in the comments! 👍

As always we’d love to hear your suggestions and ideas, so make sure to join us on our discord and add the game to your wishlists on Steam so you won’t miss out on any information!

notes.title: Shoplifters
notes.content:
Hello Pet Shop Players! 👋

Welcome back to the new Pet Shop Simulator Devlog. Today we’d like to talk about the living nightmare of each and every shop owner- shoplifters  🤯 

Not every customer comes to your shops to buy something  💰  there will also be individuals focused on looting your place under your nose. At first glance they’ll not be any different from every other guest visiting your store… don’t let them fool you!

As soon as the thief arrives next to the shelf he’d like to steal from, one will perform a pose which we’d like to call “thief gesture” which you can see on the screen below. 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/be765a38367bafbf9f697e3974bd290609de69da.png


This is an indicator that something has just been stolen and you have to take immediate action to stop the thief! 🚨 If this is the beginning of your journey as a shop manager in Pet Shop Simulator, you’ll have to stop the thief by yourself. You can do it by clicking on him and starting an interaction. This action may have two possible outcomes:

If the person indeed stole something, police will be called to take the individual to the police station and the stolen product will be back in your shop ✅

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/76bfe9f1a5a953622efedbb4d949dd33979200a1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/0fe6e4f9b90ce61686ba8ac628670a4d1753fb42.png

If the person was innocent and you point them as a thief, they’ll be mad and the overall rating of your store will take a blow  ❌



This mechanic inclines players to watch their shops carefully. Don’t be afraid- we’re not leaving you without any countermeasures! Once you’re a bit more experienced shop owner with enough money to afford extra personnel, you’ll be able to hire a store security guard and gates with sensors. Let’s take a closer look at these options 🙂

Gates will make sound the moment a shoplifter leaves the store which can be a good last resort measure to help you catch the thief 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/09c224b3eca640e8d6a78f5f8c79697c96356484.png


Security Guard will approach the thieves on his own, punish them and call the police but only when he’s able to spot them! 🧑‍✈️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/4be7bbefaf44694637d36843ed0a0aa73184e32b.png


We suggest using both of those countermeasures for the best effect! 



Let us know in the comments what you think about the shoplifting mechanics in our game. If you have any suggestions, would like to see something added, don’t hesitate to let us know! As always, we’d like to invite you to join our discord community and to add the game to your wishlists on Steam!

notes.title: Day and night cycle
notes.content:
Hello Managers! 👋

We’re always happy to have you back with us. Today, we’d like to show you a new feature added to the game. We’d like to give you a bit more diversified gameplay experience, so we decided to add the day and night cycle to the game. ☀️🌕 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/eb0abebf41ef3e47661bd1a55a82ba773259b2b6.png
The cycle will diversify your gameplay with some spare time to spend on different activities. 
At 9PM there is a 1 hour long transition from day to night. The reverse happens at 6AM and also takes an hour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/e49a2e2075ab323745d477670d0c66c289679de7.png
At the beginning of your gameplay, you’ll be able to have your shop open from 8AM to 4PM but as you progress, you’ll earn enough points to buy prolonged opening hours, at first to 7PM, eventually prolonging it to a 24h open.

When the shop is closed, you can use the spare time to clean the cages or shop, restocking the supply, buying new shelves, redoing the shop and more! 📝 Once you’re done with the changes you can choose to skip the night and move right to the opening the next day! 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/cddb1d8ad1295ce50996e60a55de6c48139ad92c.png
Keep in mind that those changes can also be performed during the day but when you want to refurnish the shop while the shop is open, it’ll require you to see all your guests out and manually close the shop before doing it. 🙁

As always we invite you to add the game to your wishlist and to join our discord community! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Employees
notes.content:
Hello Managers! 👋

Today we’d like to talk about two certain workers we’ve introduced you to in the previous devlogs. Those particular workers have a unique power of greatly impacting your sales and as the first one, we’re talking about none other than the “human directionals”. That’s right- the arrow guy! ↗️ 

His sole purpose is to encourage people to come to your store. Hiring him increases the attractiveness of your store and as a consequence, the chance a passerby will decide to enter your shop. 💰

His power of convincing people is highly relevant on his ability level. If he doesn’t know his way with the advertisement he’ll be a poor asset and often drop it. On the other hand, the highest level allows him to spin it like a pro. 💪 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/f38d2f9f8f9e7a1fc18a57f758e28556fbadc129.gif
Let’s move to the other pillar of your shop's earnings. The customer service worker will work on sealing the deal. Whenever one of your customers wonders about buying any particular good, this worker will approach and try to convince the person to buy it. 👍 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/237c55eef29e22e497edb3caba10b717f4c428ec.png
His success rate as well as the persuasion force is strictly dependent on your employee’s skill in the profession. On top of that, he can easily find any product your shop has to offer if the client wants it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/83f73d0007c198213e3d1fe17b491bf349590a30.png
Don’t forget, no matter how good this employee is, you will always have the strongest persuasive force as long as you can complete the client convincing minigame successfully. 📝

That’s it for today, we’re glad you’ve joined us again in another devlog. We’d like to invite you to join us on our discord 👇 as well as to add the game to your Wishlists on Steam to not miss on any future devlogs and announcements! 💝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Shop management
notes.content:
Hello Managers! 👋

Some of you wondered how much of a choice and control you’ll have as the owner of the pet store… With today’s devlog we’ll hopefully shed some light on this topic! 💪

First of all, we’d like to not force you to sell anything you don’t want to. Therefore, we’ve implemented an absolute freedom in the assortment. 🙂 If you dream of a shop only selling cat food- no problem! You can decide to sell only this particular product. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/710839d6743d12dcaa233732463467d6ce70ecc4.png
Though, it may not be the best strategy to maximize profit. As we’ve already mentioned in the previous devlogs part of the clients coming into the shop will look for particular items and inform you about it. 📝 If the item they’re looking for is not available they’ll leave your shop and you earn nothing. That’s why one of the challenges awaiting you will be facing clients’ requirements and ensuring diversity of offered goods in the limited space your current business offers. 🤔

The products you’ll be able to sell can be divided into categories, some of which are:

-food 🥫
-cages
-toys 🧸
-leashes, suspenders, collars 
-hygiene and healthcare ➕
-accessories (fur brushes etc.) 
-small animals 🐭

Keep in mind these are not all of them and more will be available later in the full version of the game! 🐹

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/8179483bf5e702e94f32768b0f9835ae70c0cffe.png
The process of ordering the products is pretty simple and straightforward. All you have to do is to add the products you’re interested in buying to the shopping cart and then press order. After a short while a truck 🚚 will arrive and deploy your order on a euro palette in the upload zone in front of the store. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/05c2ce7769464d52101274a311ef83816a3190b3.png
Once the order is there, you can click on the boxes to unload them automatically onto the storage shelves. Of Course first you need to have them. If you don’t have enough space, the palette will remain in the upload zone without a way to unpack it. 😥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/8371ecbe27d8acc1ba8210cbbc7d63802b32f7e7.png
If the player has space on store shelves for certain items which have been ordered, the storage worker will automatically start restocking the shelves with the items. If not, you have to designate what has to be on a particular shelf by putting the first commodity by yourself. After that as soon as the designated item appears in the storage, the shelf will be restocked automatically. 

We’d like to remind you about the possibility of expanding your store. This will offer you a solution to the lack of space and allow you to offer more variable goods! 🤩

Let us know what you think about this aspect of our game! We can’t wait to hear from you on our discord 👇 or in the comment section. If you’d like to support us, we’d love you to add Pet Shop Simulator to your wishlist! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon,
Pet Shop Team

notes.title: Parking lot
notes.content:
Hello!

We’re glad to see you again in your future Pet Shop. 🐇 Today, we’d like to direct our undivided attention to one particular asset your shop has- the parking lot. 🚗

When you first start running your shop, it comes with a small area with 4 parking spaces. But with the money you’re going to earn throughout your gameplay you can increase your parking area and buy more spaces. 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/dc02cce995e0ea163b9f45b4d2f0745b06ba2590.png
WIthout a sufficient amount of the parking spaces your potential clients who’d like to drive to your shop will drive away which causes your cash flow to stagnate. 🙁 

Therefore an investment in more spaces will most likely increase your daily income and allow you to invest more money! 🥳 💰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/d4811c2c01509e771c671143b77e97499f53f4f9.png
As you can imagine, many articles for your pets can be quite heavy and large so it’s only natural that the clients who drive to your shop are more likely to spend more money than those who walk. 🚶

When you run out of your own parking area don’t worry, you can always expand your shop and acquire all the parking spaces in the process. We’ll talk to you about it more in the future devlogs 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/b0a18eaa747d2bb20d5f5c31297c60424f426100.png
Armed with the knowledge about the impact of parking spaces on your economy, plan your business development strategy carefully! 💼 In the meantime you can join our discord and let us know your opinions and ideas about the game or add it to your wishlist on Steam to get informed about any future newses! 👇

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Employees
notes.content:
Welcome back! 👋

We are happy to see you again visiting our Pet Shop! 🙂

Last month, we’ve mentioned an important aspect of our production. Your business cannot be successful without competent, skilled employees to help you run it! 👍 Professional customer service, restocking the shop or advertising, good employees will help you do it faster, better and cheaper. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/108f13158f2938c3ddd36c70ed2e5c141b2478d9.png
As we’ve already said you’ll be able to hire employees. They’ll have different professions such as cashier, cleaner, warehouseman, customer assistant or live advertiser 📝

You’ll be able to hire as many people as you want 👱(as long as you don’t go bankrupt 😅) and customise their outfit’s colour. Each employee will have a different profession they’re proficient with and you’ll be able to send them for training so they can become even better at that job. 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/55cf85462700dd67c1f49a5fd84ea2b1b4c5879d.png
Each of the workers will have their own duties and responsibilities:

💲 Cashier - cashier customer service

notes.title: Cash register & employees
notes.content:
Hello Managers! 👋

The brand new cash registers finally arrived! Therefore, we’re ready to introduce you to the new mechanic- customer service as a cashier. 👍

From now on the players will not only be in charge of taking care of the shop but also point the clients towards the items they’re looking for, advise them (as we’ve mentioned in the previous devlog) and scan the products of their choice at the cash register.

Once the client chooses all the products they’re interested in, they’ll create a line near the cash register and wait to pay. Players will have to scan the products and receive the money, as well as give the change if needed. 💵

As the time passes, the lines will get longer and clients will lose patience. In case they wait for too long, they’ll simply leave the items next to the cash register and leave without buying anything… This will generate mess and what’s even worse- lack of income! 🙍

As always, the bigger shop, the more clients it has and naturally the lines become bigger. It’s a promise of either, huge income or an even bigger mess at the cash register… This is where the employees come in handy! 🤩

The workers will be able to take charge of the cash register and perform this task continuously without the interference of the shop owner. 🙂

Players will be able to hire the workers from the very first day of the gameplay but keep in mind, they’ll generate expenses which can hinder your growth, everything has its price. 🤔

[previewyoutube=3T8w9UeppM8;full][/previewyoutube]
On top of that, as we’ve explained in the previous devlog, there will be few different kinds of clients. We’d like to show you a little insight into the works on their animations- which proceeds smoothly! Below, you can see two different animations of a client who looks for something! As you can see, they are quite suggestive! 👏

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/3c2936c38025316ab32ac4e3ba3c3ae6ff6eed0b.gif
That’s it for today! Don’t forget to join our discord 👇 and let us know your opinions and suggestions about the contents of the game! 🤩 If you haven’t already, add this game to your wishlists 👇 to not miss on any further update!

notes.title: Customers
notes.content:
Players, welcome to our second devlog! 👋

This time, we’d like to introduce you to one of the most important mechanics in the Pet Shop Simulator- customer service. 😀

But before we get to the main topic, we’d like to tell you that we’re constantly working on developing the building mode we introduced you to in the previous devlog!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/e8a125b8d5af0349a899d526a6e07358be857300.png
We’re adding more and more objects to the game. We also gave you an ability to paint almost everything to with color available in the game and introduced warehouse management via tablet. 📱

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/368fc5b50b25a4fe72acf91ce13ec9aa48f78528.png
Currently, the customers you’ll encounter in your shops can be separated into three different groups.

Group 1- customers who know what they want

This is the easiest group to work with. Those NPCs will look for a specific item. You can identify them by the dialog cloud over their head. 🔍

Your task is to approach and when they tell you what item they need, find and sell it to them- it’s that easy! 👍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/2f165d0bbbf4831032b520f31d198f827763b436.png
Group 2- customers who want to find something

This time around, you’ll have to show those NPCs the way to an appropriate shelf. If the item the client looks for is available in your store- you’ll sell it to them. If it’s not, well… you’ll have to pass the information and disappoint them which in result makes the client leave your store! 😢

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/12aa45054a428f4c320426cb14729a215e2684ea.png
Group 3- (our personal favorite) undecided customers

During your encounters with those customers, your task will be the most demanding one- convincing them to purchase a certain item. You can identify such clients because of their behavior. Those NPCs will stand next to an item for a prolonged period of time. 🧍

To succeed, you’ll have to enter a conversation with the client and choose correct dialog options (A/B or C) to fill the “persuasion” bar over their head. 📝

The difficulty level will be different for those customers. Sometimes, you’ll quickly convince the client to put something into their shopping carts and sometimes it’s going to take more effort! 🤩

But be careful- if you don’t pay attention to NPCs’ reactions you risk making them irritated 😡 and if you keep pushing even make them leave your shop or lose interest in the mentioned item. 

That brings us to an end of this devlog. Join our discord community 👇 and give us your thoughts on the clients mechanic! Don't forget to add our game to your wishlist 👇 to not miss on any further update!

Pet Shop Team

notes.title: Introduction
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We are excited to welcome you to the first devlog in our new production- Pet Shop Simulator! 🥳🎉

The devlogs are going to appear regularly 📅 and we are very happy to create it and share the progress with all of you! Therefore, we’d like to invite you to add the game to your wishlist 👇 to both follow and have an impact on the process of creating this game! 🤩

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/ 

If you want to have an easy way to interact with our dev team and make sure your suggestions and opinions are heard directly by them, we suggest joining our discord 👇 where you can interact with them as well as other members of the community❣️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png 

We plan the graphics to have a candy vibe 🍬 which is going to resonate with the cuteness of all the pets we plan to introduce to our game. 😍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/d598d7424fc14686d3582347aeca27a6a200dbbd.png

As for what you are going to be able to do besides the actual management of the shop… One of those things will be planning the shop layout. 📝 

There will be multiple rooms waiting for you: the office, storage rooms, toilets, the shopping hall, the employees room and more! What’s even better, you’ll get to decide the size and position of the rooms!

The starting shop won’t be a big one but as you spend more time earning money 💰 you’ll have an opportunity to buy the neighboring stores to expand your business!

You’ll also get to increase the parking space in front of your shop to increase the amount of customers able to drive to your shop! 👷

Not only that! You’ll also be able to inspect the area around your Pet Store. We also plan to give you a full control of that area 🖌️ and possibility to add elements not only inside the store but in the close vicinity of the building which is the entire area belonging to the shop premises! 🏡

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/f4ced12cf4e26561aec2d55812544ffd140f1b30.png

Unfortunately, that brings us to the end of this short devlog but before you go we have a question for you! 🤔

What animals would you like to see in the game? We can’t wait to hear your answers so let us know in the comments! 🤩

See you soon,
Pet Shop Team
